import hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
import modal

def identity():
    paths=list(Path('/usr/share/tesseract-ocr').rglob('eng.traineddata'))
    return {'version':subprocess.check_output(['tesseract','--version'],text=True,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT),'packages':subprocess.check_output(['dpkg-query','-W','tesseract-ocr','tesseract-ocr-eng','libtesseract5','liblept5'],text=True),'traineddata':[{'path':str(p),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'bytes':p.stat().st_size} for p in paths]}

if __name__=='__main__':
    image=modal.Image.debian_slim(python_version='3.11').apt_install('tesseract-ocr=5.3.0-2','tesseract-ocr-eng=1:4.1.0-2')
    app=modal.App('qpaf-m23-preflight')
    f=app.function(image=image,cpu=1,memory=1024,timeout=120,retries=0,max_containers=1)(identity)
    with modal.enable_output(),app.run():
        result=f.remote()
    path=Path('.superpowers/m23/runtime-preflight.json')
    path.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
